reports.title: 10x Genomics Reports Third Quarter 2026 Financial Results

guidance.heading: 2026 Financial Guidance
section: 10x Genomics is raising its full year 2026 revenue guidance and now expects revenue in the range of $625 million to $635 million, versus the previous range of $610 million to $630 million. Excluding the non-recurring license and royalty revenue related to patent litigation settlements in both 2026 and 2025, this represents 4% to 6% growth over full year 2025.
